step.label: Monitor workplace hazard events
step.description: Continuously detect and log occupational safety incidents across all facilities to establish incident baseline and trigger compliance workflows.
step.useCase: Safety managers need real-time visibility into workplace hazards before they escalate into reportable incidents.

step.label: Evaluate hazardous substance exposure
step.description: Assess chemical and material safety compliance status against regulatory standards to determine risk level and remediation requirements.
step.useCase: Operations teams must validate that all hazardous materials in use meet environmental and occupational safety regulations.

step.label: Analyze equipment maintenance impact
step.description: Review maintenance schedules and change requests to identify equipment-related safety risks that could contribute to incidents or compliance violations.
step.useCase: Maintenance planners need to understand how equipment changes or delays impact workplace safety compliance posture.

step.label: Verify customer safety compliance status
step.description: Cross-reference customer accounts and campaigns against safety compliance records to ensure contractual safety obligations are met.
step.useCase: Account managers must confirm that customer-facing safety commitments and campaign execution align with organizational compliance standards.

step.label: Review employee payroll and staffing impact
step.description: Examine payroll records for affected employees to assess financial and staffing implications of safety incidents or compliance remediation activities.
step.useCase: HR and finance teams need to understand incident-related costs (incident response, lost time, reassignment) on payroll and headcount planning.

step.label: Check employee absence and availability
step.description: Validate employee time-off balances to ensure adequate staffing for safety remediation tasks and incident investigation activities.
step.useCase: Incident response coordinators must confirm that required safety personnel are available and not on approved leave before assignment.

step.label: Track customer engagement in compliance campaigns
step.description: Update customer contact states and campaign journey status to reflect participation in safety compliance communications and training.
step.useCase: Marketing and compliance teams must ensure customers receive timely safety alerts and compliance notifications through appropriate channels.

step.label: Reconcile safety costs and revenue impact
step.description: Match remediation and incident costs against customer invoices and material usage to quantify financial impact of compliance activities.
step.useCase: Finance and executive leadership need complete visibility into compliance program ROI and incident-related cost recovery from customers.
